# Pennsylvania Psychiatric Institute

> Pennsylvania Psychiatric Institute (PPI) is a comprehensive mental health and behavioral health provider offering specialized psychiatric programs for adults, children, adolescents, and geriatric patients across Central Pennsylvania.

Based in Harrisburg and affiliated with Penn State Health, PPI provides inpatient, outpatient, and partial hospitalization services including evidence-based treatments like ECT, DBT, and opioid replacement therapy. The institute serves diverse populations including Spanish-speaking communities and specializes in conditions ranging from first-episode psychosis to reproductive psychiatry.

## Psychiatric Programs

- [Psychiatric Programs Overview](https://ppimhs.org/programs): Overview of psychiatric programs including ECT, DBT, AIR, and CAPSTONE
- [Adult Psychiatric Programs](https://ppimhs.org/programs/adult-psychiatric-programs): Adult inpatient, outpatient, and partial hospitalization programs at PPI
- [Child and Adolescent Psychiatric Programs](https://ppimhs.org/programs/child-adolescent-psychiatric-programs): Child and adolescent inpatient/outpatient services for behavioral and mood disorders
- [Mature Adult Psychiatric Programs](https://ppimhs.org/programs/mature-adult-psychiatric-programs): Geriatric psychiatric programs for older adults including assessment and medication
- [Hispanic Psychiatric Programs](https://ppimhs.org/programs/hispanic-psychiatric-programs): Spanish-language psychiatric services with bilingual staff in Harrisburg
- [Reproductive Psychiatry Services](https://ppimhs.org/programs/reproductivepsychiatry): Specialized maternal and reproductive mental health services for women

## Specialized Treatment Programs

- [Electroconvulsive Therapy (ECT)](https://ppimhs.org/programs/electroconvulsive-therapy-ect): ECT treatment guide, procedure details, and patient referral information
- [Dialectical Behavior Therapy (DBT)](https://ppimhs.org/programs/dialectical-behavior-therapy-dbt): DBT program for borderline personality disorder with skills training
- [Advancement In Recovery (AIR) Program](https://ppimhs.org/programs/advancement-in-recovery-air-program-opioid-treatment-program): Opioid treatment program offering methadone, Suboxone, and counseling services
- [CAPSTONE Program / First Episode Psychosis](https://ppimhs.org/programs/capstone-program-first-episode-psychosis): Early intervention program for first-episode psychosis with peer support
